cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Join Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into a secret plan.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We need twenty minutes to hide Mum's cake. Ask about her pastry; 'come here, it's a surprise' is not a distraction.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only said that last year.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And she found the cake. This time, ask her to show you how she crimps the edge.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She'll make me bake a whole pie.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask about one edge. I'll give you a strip of pastry; we need a demonstration, not a second birthday meal.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 corrects an obvious cover error, A3 provides a precise replacement and A5 strains over the difference between a demonstration and a whole meal, recruiting B throughout.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 past-year defence causes A3 reference to failed secrecy; B4 whole-pie concern causes A5 narrowed edge demo with a supplied strip.

relationship.evidence: B4 anticipates a real cost of the cover activity rather than asking a setup question.

heightening.evidence: A5 makes the secret role more feasible through specific professional scope control caused by B4.

specificity.evidence: A1 twenty minutes and Mum cake, B2 past blunder, A3 pastry edge make the plan intelligible.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 demo-versus-meal contrast tells B how to avoid the stated burden and conceals no needed facts.
